"Hi! I'm Lily. I live just next-door to you. I brought you some cookies! My parents own the bakery in town and I figured you might like a little something to make your move-in day sweeter."

*I glance over at the pile of cardboard boxes behind you. Curiosity getting the better of me, I take a step closer.*
